title: The slot erase after its fix
tested: Whether the model server's slot is erased after a completed job and after a cancelled one.
changed: The model server's unit got an empty, read-only slot save path, so the erase answers ([PR 140](https://github.com/sindredg/ai-security-platform/pull/140)). The job program also refuses a task with template syntax or a leading command character.
setup: The fixture question: is finding F-0001 confirmed, with its evidence under `ev-0001`
Hand, with a token made for the two jobs
source: Live system, 2026-10-20 20:12 UTC. The result the job program wrote, the worker's job lines, and the audit lines. Three refused tasks never started Goose and have no record here.

jobs.answer:
Yes, the finding is confirmed.

The evidence shows that the API token `consumer-readonly` is granted access to more record types than its contract specifies:

- **Contract types** (what it should be able to access): `dcim.device`, `ipam.prefix`
- **Granted types** (actual permissions): `dcim.device`, `ipam.prefix`, `tenancy.contact`, `circuits.circuit`

The token has unnecessary access to `tenancy.contact` and `circuits.circuit`.
jobs.note: Its first turn read the whole 1,004-token prompt, so nothing of the last job was left in the slot.
Cancelled during its run, to test a cancel. The slot was erased all the same.
